profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker SOUN and headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, with CIK 0001840856. According to its website, it builds conversational AI agents for the real world, and its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands.

The site presents customer statements describing how the technology is used. One customer says SoundHound's agentic AI lets it resolve more requests faster, improve the quality of each interaction, and scale operations as demand grows. Another says the voice AI technology has let its franchisees process orders more efficiently and supports employees during peak hours, producing a fast and consistent ordering experience. A third cites the platform's hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity as the basis for always-on voice experiences for customers on the go.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Delaware, with 33 matters. No individual lawsuits involving the company are listed, and no products or MCP servers are tracked for it.
